decoder.name: ConvCTC-M async + es char 6-gram beam (Fidetype)
decoder.weights_licence: not released (trained on CC BY-NC 4.0 data: research only)
training_data: Tatoeba es (CC BY 2.0 FR) for the char LM

policy.name: trust gate + LTT
policy.description: commit threshold by Learn then Test, alpha 0.05, delta 0.1

cer.basis: aggregate of the committed run (no per-trial CER)

shuffled.basis: per-trial CER of the M1-09 control run (beam + LM, val-tuned; same network)

zeros.basis: per-trial CER of the M1-09 control run (beam + LM, val-tuned; same network)

null_commit.basis: P6-01 null audit at this entry's threshold (LTT lambda 0.0000), zeros MEG input, n=637; commits per null input: shuffled_meg 0/637, zeros_meg 0/637, other_sentence 15/637, frame_shuffled 8/637, uniform 0/637

guarantee.scope: marginal wrong-commit rate over test trials; assumes calibration and test trials are exchangeable

conformance.checked: the M1-09 stream files (local); they predate the M5-10 adapter and lack device.modality, decoder.causal, data.derived and language. The current adapter reaches provenance on synthetic input; rerun infer.py to get trust-ready streams.

notes: Decoder CER: greedy 0.508, beam + LM val-tuned 0.477 (pooled over trials). The trust pipeline decodes with its own beam (RETUNED, lm_weight 0.5, frame temperature): CER 0.522.
trust gate + LTT: commit threshold on calibrated p_top1 0.0000 (fitted on the 437 val trials).

safe_wpm.timing: track rate model: len(truth) * 60 / 152 chars/min (no per-trial timing in the committed data)

correction_rule.name: rewrite
correction_rule.formula: 2 s + 0.7895 s/char * len(truth) per wrong commit

safe_wpm.no_bci_note: gaze typing of every sentence at 20 chars/min (the eWPM reference)

basis.shuffled: per-trial CER of the M1-09 control run (beam + LM, val-tuned; same network)
basis.zeros: per-trial CER of the M1-09 control run (beam + LM, val-tuned; same network)
basis.null_commit: P6-01 null audit at this entry's threshold (LTT lambda 0.0000), zeros MEG input, n=637; commits per null input: shuffled_meg 0/637, zeros_meg 0/637, other_sentence 15/637, frame_shuffled 8/637, uniform 0/637
